# G1.0 entry fixtures

This directory retains non-normative entry evidence for G1.0. It records the
observed needs of the fixed Gate 1 slices and executable consumer shapes for
the future web and native token transforms.

The inventory does not own token IDs, values, types, aliases, modes, override
policies, binding recipes, fallbacks, public renderer APIs, or runtime-profile
strategies. Those facts remain unavailable until the milestone is activated
and are then authored only by their architecture-declared canonical owners.

The consumer modules accept synthetic transform results so their consumption
requirements can be proved before `@core-ui/tokens`, `@core-ui/web`, or
`@core-ui/react-native` exists. They are not renderer implementations or
generated-output specifications.

`packed-compatibility-source.json` is a closed, test-only pack input. The
fixture projection resolves exact binding revisions and per-profile token and
platform-safety digests from the generated catalog package, then builds a
synthetic descriptor/release correlation for E-G1.0-04 and E-G1.0-07. It does
not create a renderer package, export, support result, publication candidate,
or release-readiness claim.
